div.div:
① The maintainer approves the request
② The harness creates a worktree and starts kiro-cli under the sandbox
③ Commits go to the per-item object directory, not to the main .git/objects
④ Imported after the process exits
⑤ Checked
⑥ A draft PR is opened after approval
⑦ The maintainer marks it ready and merges
⑧ Red dashed: path after a stop (the harness deletes nothing)
